verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes unauthenticated public access to statistics surfaces including leaderboards.
First concrete failure showing public referral totals at zero despite recorded referral activity.
Target-specific implementation claim that aggregate referral data are now accurate.
The client accepts excluding old-contract NFTs and their data from the active system.
The client explicitly defines the required ticket and commission totals and their pairing on public statistics.
The client removes historical backfill while retaining prospective accounting accuracy.
The client accepts the one-time first-mint exception proposed in the immediately preceding context.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
So far, we have done 12 mints, that should equal 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**When there is no referral code used, there is still a ticket and commission**.

Right now, **when a code is used**, it is correctly accounted for on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

When there is **no referral code used**, the ticket and commission are randomly assigned.
(B**ut they still need to be accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I think since your last fix, (on the last 2 mints) the randomly assigned tickets have been accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
But they have not been backfilled to show the missing tickets.

And the commissions (from these no code buys) are still not being accounted for on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot you'll see i have an NFT with 2 tickets and only 1 x $5 commission - this should be impossible, as every ticket comes with a $5 commission.

And on my leaderboard screenshot, you can count (from 12 total mints) 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions accounted for.
12 mints should equal 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions, regardless of a referral code being used or not.

execution.observed_behavior: After 12 mints, the leaderboard showed only seven tickets and five $5 commissions, and an NFT showed two tickets but only one commission.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I have finished implementing a temporary backend logic. Can you check if the commission and tickets are reflected well now? Then I'll tell you what we can do next

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports implementing temporary backend logic intended to make commission and ticket totals display correctly.
